Welcome To NYIT! 
Studying in a foreign country is an exciting and challenging experience. We congratulate you for 
taking on this challenge. This guide will prepare you with information about F-1 or J-1 student 
status, your arrival to New York, and your first few weeks on campus.  
For many of you, this will be your first time in New York and in the United States. We are here to 
help you with your adjustment to a new school, community, country, and culture. You are joining 
more than 1,300 international undergraduate and graduate students from nearly 100 nations at 
our campuses in Manhattan and Old Westbury.  
Office of International Education  
The Office of International Education supports and nurtures international students at NYIT by
